LESSON: READING 6.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we obtain information from texts? 2. What stories or books have you read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a variety of dialogues related to email and the internet for comprehension,
2. apply appropriate intensive reading skills to obtain specific factual and inferential information for lifelong learning,
3. adopt reading for purposes of comprehension and information.
